hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap curve that bypasses Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. On each swap, the hook takes the full input from the pool manager, calls phiEth.deposit or phiEth.withdraw to convert it 1:1, then settles the output — fully absorbing the swap via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Adding liquidity directly to the pool always reverts.
